slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that make discipline
feel like an addiction

tracking your runs

run three times a week and log every run in a notebook. watching your times slowly drop is more addictive than any online streak, and it's real progress.

learning a song a month

learn one full song on an instrument every month. the moment you finally play it through without mistakes is a reward that makes you want the next one.

a garden from seeds

grow vegetables from seed on a balcony or in a garden. daily care with a slow harvest teaches your brain that patience pays off in the most satisfying way.

a daily learning streak

learn something new in 5 minutes every day and never break the chain: a fact, a word, a painting. a streak you're proud of quietly turns discipline into a habit.
slides.texte_sophia:
a daily learning streak

learn something new in 5 minutes every day and never break the chain. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and a streak you're proud of turns discipline into habit.

slides.texte_overlay:
cold morning walks

walk for twenty minutes every morning before breakfast, even in winter. doing a slightly hard thing first makes every other hard thing that day feel easier.
